title: The Missing Note
caption: THE OBSERVER WORLD — Chapter I, Episode 7: The Missing Note. One note is missing from the song. The Keeper searches the turning world and stops when he meets another keeper — and asks him for it. But the note is not his to give. Instead he lays out the scale on the ground — Do Re Mi Fa Sol La Ti Do — and the two play it note by note. Where Fa should ring, there is only silence: that empty step is the missing note. They give it back its place, the scale rings whole, and the two walk on. (The hidden lesson: the major scale, and finding a note by ear.)  the more you know, the more you observe.  #theobserver #animation #ambient #music #solfege #storytelling
